broker-gate-tests.cmd: cd management-api && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -2 && node --test tests/broker-bridge.test.js 2>&1 | tail -12

extraDisciplines: self-referential: agentbox contains the dream-engine that dreams it (services/dream-engine). A change to that crate changes the dreamer itself — apply extra review scrutiny, and never let a self-modifying hypothesis bypass the human-merge gate. Still evidence-gated, still witnessed.

nix-build-out-of-annexe: the full image build (flake.nix) needs nixpkgs and the host build shell (tmux tab 6) — the connected node annexe cannot run it. The evaluable surface here is the Rust crates + node hook syntax. Record image/Nix findings as 'HANDOFF (rebuild):' notes; never invent a nix-build evaluator that would silently no-op.

sibling-path-deps: services/nostr-pod-bridge path-deps the nostr-rust-forum and solid-pod-rs sibling repos (../../../../); since 2026-09-07 the engine ships them to the annexe at their real workspace depth (annexeInclude), so the sovereign-mesh-bridge evaluator is a REAL required gate. Changes to the sibling crates themselves still belong to those repos' own cycles — propose there, not here.
secrets-never-in-report: agentbox holds keys and env; never quote .env, agentbox/.env, or any *_KEY/*_PRIVKEY value into a report, ledger, or gist.

cite-existing-adrs: cite only ADR ids that exist under docs/adr/ (4-digit ADR-2xxx ledger + the archived 3-digit corpus); propose a new decision by title and leave the id to the operator — nights have cited ADR-056/ADR-0057/ADR-2024 that do not exist.

ontology-monitor-evaluators: the required ontology-governance-tests exercise management-api/tests/ontology-propose-vault.test.js and ontology-apply.test.js against the current vault CLI boundary. Corpus parsing, frontmatter validation, links and reasoning are owned and tested by the upstream vault crate, whose tests also run in lib/vault.nix. The advisory broker-gate-tests exercise management-api/tests/broker-bridge.test.js. Scan proposal-idempotency reads management-api/lib/ontology-propose.js; broker-gate reads management-api/routes/broker-bridge.js. Cite receipts from these, never infer from headers.
